bio: Principal investigator of SHARK-NIR, with instrument engineering contributions to PLATO and MORFEO.
long_bio: Jacopo is the principal investigator of SHARK-NIR, the near-infrared high-contrast camera at the Large Binocular Telescope. His work spans instrument design and development for high angular-resolution astronomy, together with collaborations involving optical systems for PLATO and MORFEO. These efforts support the observation of faint companions and circumstellar material close to bright stars.
